title: Wheelwright v5 Lug
description: Phase 1 schema for the v5 lug. Built ALONGSIDE the v4 lug schema (validate_lug_v4.py / lug-schema-v4). Nothing in the running v4 harness reads or writes this shape yet — see docs/wheelwright-v5-control-plane-directive.md Part IV Doctrine 2 (strangler cutover: fully old or fully new, flipped by a recorded transition receipt, no dual-read window).

model_provider_ref.description: The model+provider that performed an attributed action (directive S28).

lug_type.description: Semantic hierarchy position (directive S2/S3). GOALS live on spoke/group objects, not lugs, so 'goal' is not a lug type here.

value_record.description: One immutable entry in an append-only value log (directive S5). A slot ('drafted'|'ready'|'actual') is set at most once per log by convention enforced in lug_v5.py, never by schema alone, because JSON Schema cannot express 'this array position, once written, cannot be replaced' — that invariant is the append-only list plus the pure set_value() function which refuses to overwrite an occupied slot.

value.description: The numeric/estimate value for this slot. null is legal only when explicitly marked unknown via value_unknown=true (directive S37 — never fabricate a zero).

value_unknown.description: True when this slot has no recorded value and none should be inferred (e.g. a migrated v4 lug that never carried a ready/actual figure).

value_triple.description: Append-only value evolution log for one measured quantity (effort or impact) per directive S5. Never overwrite earlier entries; append a new value_record for each refinement. history is the single source of truth; drafted/ready/actual are DERIVED read-only projections (first entry of each slot found in history), included for convenience.

history.description: Append-only. Each element is immutable once written. Ordered by recorded_at (enforced by lug_v5.py, not by schema).

descendant_prompt_entry.description: One layer of instruction lineage (directive S4). The full lineage from root to leaf is reconstructed by walking parent_id up through lineage.ancestors, reading each ancestor's own descendant_prompt.

text.description: The incremental instruction this lug adds for its children, layered on top of (never replacing) inherited instruction.

lineage.description: Provenance sufficient to reconstruct the instruction lineage from root to leaf (directive S4) and to identify inherited goals/impact/directions.

parent_id.description: Immediate parent lug id, or null for a root (initiative-level) lug.

ancestors.description: Ordered root-to-immediate-parent chain of ancestor ids. Empty for a root lug. This is a durable snapshot recorded at creation time (S28: parent is part of durable attribution) — it is not re-derived from a live graph walk, so lineage survives a parent's later move/deletion.

initiative_id.description: The initiative this lug's IMPACT is contextual to (directive S2).

inherited_goals.description: Goal identifiers inherited from spoke/group (directive S2/S16), copied down so a descendant does not need a live graph walk to know what goals influence it.

inherited_directions.description: DIRECTIONS text inherited from the parent implementation lug (directive S2).

state_transition.description: One durable, attributed lifecycle transition record (directive S7 + S28). History is never silently mutated — transitions are appended, never edited or removed.

model_profile.description: Required intelligence profile, established at READY_TO_BUILD (directive S8). Evaluator decides WHAT is required; Alchemist decides WHERE/HOW to obtain it economically.

quality_floor.description: Minimum acceptable output quality bar, e.g. 'draft', 'production', 'critical'.

effort_budget.description: Ceiling on spend/tokens/time allotted for this lug's build, in whatever unit Alchemist standardizes on.

acceptable_fallback_class.description: Ordered list of classes Alchemist may substitute if the requested class is unavailable/uneconomical.

attribution.description: Durable attribution (directive S28). Every field here is set once at the relevant event and never silently rewritten; last_modified_* is updated only by appending awareness that a modification happened — the modification itself is also captured as a state_transition or an explicit revision note where it changes substantive content.

created_by.description: Human/session/agent identity that created the lug.

owner.description: Current responsible owner (may differ from creator).

legacy_provenance.description: Migration provenance (directive S37). Present whenever this lug's record originated from a v4 migration rather than native v5 creation.

unknown_fields.description: Names of v5 fields that could not be populated from the v4 source and were marked legacy/unknown rather than fabricated (directive S37: a v4 lug with no impact value gets an explicit unknown marker, not a zero).

state.description: Current lifecycle state. The legal-transition table lives in lug_v5.py:TRANSITIONS and is enforced by the pure function can_transition()/apply_transition(), not by this schema (JSON Schema cannot express 'valid next values depend on current value').

directions.description: DIRECTIONS (directive S2): what specifically this implementation lug must address. Explicit enough that descendants can act without reconstructing intent from conversation history. Corresponds to v4's perceive/execute prose.

descendant_prompt.description: This lug's own incremental instruction layer for its children (directive S4). Absent when this lug produces no descendants.

evidence.description: Carried forward verbatim from the v4 lug's evidence/verify content where present (directive S36: migrated lugs preserve evidence).

relationships.description: Carried-forward relationship fields (blocked_by, spec_id, etc.) preserved from v4.

effort.description: EFFORT value triple (directive S2: EFFORT belongs to child work / verification lugs; directive S5/S6: forecast first, observation later, drafted/ready/actual, never overwritten).

impact.description: IMPACT value triple (directive S2: IMPACT belongs to initiatives, contextual to current goals).

model_profile.description: Required at/after READY_TO_BUILD (directive S8). Enforced by lug_v5.py's transition guard, not by this schema, since it is conditional on state.

goals.description: GOALS (directive S2): present only on spoke/group-scoped records this lug references; a plain implementation/child_work/verification lug does not carry its own goals field, it carries lineage.inherited_goals instead. Reserved for forward compatibility with spoke/group objects sharing this schema family.

history.description: Append-only durable log of every lifecycle transition (directive S7+S28). Single source of truth for lifecycle history; never mutated in place, only appended.

legacy.description: Present iff this record was produced by migrate_v4_lug(). Absent on natively-created v5 lugs.
